policy.framing: Widescreen gameplay inside the existing portrait canvas; preserve context rather than guessing a GTA character crop.
policy.subtitles: Existing plain two-line dialogue captions; preserve source language. ASR/word timing and platform overlays still need QC.
policy.music_and_sfx: Off by default. No automatic emotion-to-asset selection, unlicensed assets or speech-masking effects.
policy.duration: Reject out-of-band recommendations instead of blindly truncating dialogue.
policy.safe_area: 30 percent bottom inset is a conservative local preset, not certified universal TikTok/Reels/Shorts clearance. Horizontal bounds still require review.
